ModMetaData.name: Ancient Urban Ruins (HSK Patched)
ModMetaData.author: MO - HSK conversion by CarbineAction
ModMetaData.description:
All-in-one HSK-balanced fork of Ancient Urban Ruins by MO.
Player-craftable buildings and weapons rebalanced to match HSK's smelter-based economy:
BUILDINGS (~119 craftable): - Raw <Steel> -> <SteelBar> (HSK refined alloy) on every player-buildable def - Functional buildings (Generator, Workbench, Television, Electrical Box, Elevators, Virtual Miner) get HSK component pattern (ComponentIndustrial / ComponentSpacer / ElectronicComponents) where appropriate - Decorative buildings (signs, chess pieces, indicators, mall benches, etc.) get bulk Steel->SteelBar swap
WEAPONS (~35 craftable): - Raw <Steel> -> <SteelBar> on every craftable weapon - HSKRNRouter handles weapon-bench routing and crafting components automatically at runtime
UNTOUCHED: - Apparel (7 items): already use AUR's custom AM_AramidCloth / AM_UHMWPEPlate / AM_HeavyCompositePlate materials - no Steel involved - Items (14 medical/LEGO): use Cloth / Neutroamine / MedicineHerbal - no Steel involved - Loot/spawn-only props (~150 buildings: ruins, trash, broken cars, signs etc.): no costList, can't be crafted, nothing to convert - CE compatibility: untouched (the original mod's /CE/ folder still works)
Drop-in replacement - incompatibleWith upstream so they can't double-load. Switch back to upstream Workshop version when not playing HSK.
Credits to MO for the original mod.
